items.summary: Security disposition is evidence_needed. Fleet-doctor has no run or findings, and operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. TLS has no recorded certificate expiring within 30 days, but coverage is incomplete and this is not clearance. Compliance reports 20 failed and 6 unknown sites. Recommendation: block security-sensitive releases and new public exposure; permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Continue the existing read-only evidence matrix without duplicate telemetry, credential access, exploitation, configuration changes, deployment, or external outreach.
